violation_type.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required (26 TAC §746.4307)
violation_type.typical_finding: On the infant/toddler playground they is only one exit, the fence area needs another exit.

finding_variants.text: On the infant/toddler playground they is only one exit, the fence area needs another exit.
The operation did not have two exits out of a fenced area in the playground.
The playground only has one exit.
The operation's fenced playground only had one exit.
The childcare operation lacks a key/key code for building access during outdoor activities which poses a significant safety risk for children in the event of an emergency.
During the inspection, the door of the gate to exit the Pre-K playground would not open.  This could pose a hazard for children to successfully evaluate away from the building.

Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Exits Required: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being recited. While there is a second gate opening at the end of the outdoor play area, children can not safely exit through the gate. On the other side, the exit is blocked by broken palm tree leaves, bushes, trash, and other hazards that make it impossible for a safe exit in case the first exit is unavailable for emergencies.
